limitations: Unscored main-thread/worker-thread user hardware-counter diagnostic; initialization, warmups and output validation excluded.
Node barrier and Promise-return edge instructions remain in counter bounds. Node background compilation/GC and other Scriptw threads are excluded.
Counts are raw hardware events with full counter running time. They are not request timings, causal allocation shares, or a partition of the runtime gap.

Current sampled callchains and allocator controls retain their own build and process identities. Older diagnostics remain in the Git-bound baseline archive. Inclusive sampling shares overlap and do not predict wall-time gains.

sampled_diagnostics.scope: Current Fast sync worker only; 100 checked requests after three warmups; excluded from scored cohorts.
sampled_diagnostics.limits: User-cycle sample weights, never wall-time shares or exact call counts. Own samples are disjoint; inclusive owners overlap. Frame-pointer chains can truncate or be invalid, and missing callers remain explicit. Caller return PCs resolve at IP-1. No silent cross-process rebasing.
sampled_diagnostics.full_derived_rows: Regenerate from archived samples/maps using the retained symbolizer; original full-file hashes are preserved in derived-callchains-mapping.json.

component_control.limits: Previous sampled/allocator diagnostics retain their own identities in the Git-bound baseline report; current samples belong only to this outlined candidate.

diagnosis.limits: Own user-cycle sample weights. Page-touch regions and entry stack-check immediates decoded from retained same-process prefixes/objdump text; budgets include ABI/alignment overhead. Inclusive caller shares overlap. Not wall-time shares, exact allocation counts or predictions of source-optimization gains. Allocator A/B uses its own four-process-per-arm host; scored RSC uses the normal frozen host.

ownership.limits: User-cycle sample relationships, not exact call counts or wall-time shares. Inclusive owners and path subsets overlap. These motivate a private-descriptor experiment without predicting its gain.

allocator_diagnostic.limits: Unscored allocator-only diagnostic; identical source/P/R and OptLevel::None; four fresh processes per arm. Product defaults and scored timing configuration unchanged.
